eventMetadata.context_description: Persistent southwest monsoon (habagat) activity, with widespread cloud cover, scattered thunderstorms, and moderate-to-heavy rainfall across Luzon, is the main driver keeping Manila's August 17 maximum temperatures clustered near 28–29 °C according to PAGASA and global model guidance. These conditions reduce solar insolation and enhance evaporative cooling, limiting daytime heating relative to climatological August averages near 31 °C. Model spread in timing and intensity of convective cells creates the narrow edge between 28 °C and 29 °C outcomes, while drier breaks or stronger insolation could briefly push readings to 30 °C. Updated PAGASA forecasts and high-resolution model runs through the weekend will further refine the distribution ahead of resolution.
